title: Memorandum for record: marking of exercise products
unit: Task Force LANTERN, S1 and S2
subject: Banner marking and format of Exercise QUIET HARBOR products

references.title: DoDM 5200.01 Volume 2, DoD Information Security Program: Marking of Information

guidance: Every exercise product carries the banner UNCLASSIFIED // FOR TRAINING at the top and bottom of each page or slide.
No product contains classified information. Fictional names (Varrow, Kestrel Bay, VLF) are used throughout.
Memoranda follow the AR 25-50 format; orders follow the five-paragraph format.
A revised product keeps its number and states its revision on the title line, as OPORD 26-03 REVISION 1 does.
Real-world reference material in the share keeps its original markings and is not re-marked.
